title: B2AGI Physical AI 2027: Cluster Atlas Top 20

records.name: Pearl River Delta Core — Shenzhen–Dongguan
records.role: Robot engineering, incubation and manufacturing access
records.selection_rationale: Shenzhen and Dongguan connect sensor and robot development with engineering education, prototyping facilities and manufacturing access. XbotPark's university and startup programmes link talent development to product engineering.
records.evidence_scope: Located development and incubation in Shenzhen and Dongguan; named XbotPark startup outcomes and HKUST's April 2026 educational visit. Shenzhen's 2024 academy incubation total covers hardware entrepreneurship. Overseas customers and Hong Kong educational origins retain their locations.

sources.locator: Guangdong-Hong Kong Robotics Academy: established September 2015; university-linked 2+2 programme and entrepreneurial immersion; Songshan Lake, Dongguan.
Professional Training: technical lectures, product-development support, student final-year projects and shared laboratories. Undated programme description.

sources.title: HKUST account of XbotPark incubation
sources.locator: Named incubated companies Narwal, Hai Robotics and EcoFlow. HKUST ATC student counts concern Hong Kong, not local Dongguan enrolment; projected unicorns are not completed outcomes.

sources.title: HKUST GBA entrepreneurship learning trip
sources.locator: Dongguan Hard-Tech Incubation Hub: educational visit to XbotPark in Songshan Lake. A site visit establishes educational contact, not a measured training-to-product success rate.

sources.title: Shenzhen 2024 development report and 2025 plan
sources.locator: 2024 results, section two: Nanshan entrepreneurship academy in use and 16 incubated angel-stage projects. This hardware-entrepreneurship total is not a robotics-company count.

records.assessment_focus: Robot engineering, incubation and manufacturing access

records.name: San Francisco Bay Area
records.role: Robotics platforms, learning research and shared facilities
records.selection_rationale: The Bay Area combines model and robotics-platform development with Berkeley's robot-learning education and Stanford's shared physical research facilities. Reusable software and product companies connect research to physical systems.
records.evidence_scope: Development across San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara and Alameda counties; Berkeley's Spring 2026 course and Stanford Robotics Center's physical research bays. Global platform adoption and site-specific operations retain separate geographic scopes.

sources.locator: UC Berkeley CS 185/285 Deep Reinforcement Learning, Spring 2026: Sergey Levine; course materials, assignments and final-project programme. Berkeley is in Alameda County.

sources.title: Stanford Robotics Center facilities
sources.locator: Shared experimental space, six research bays and student/researcher/corporate network; launch 2024-11-01. Underwater tank remains in development.

records.assessment_focus: Robotics platforms, learning research and shared facilities

records.name: Yangtze River Delta Core — Shanghai–Hangzhou–Suzhou
records.role: Training infrastructure, robot products and physical research
records.selection_rationale: The cluster brings Shanghai’s training infrastructure and Hangzhou’s robots and physical-system research into one analytical region, tracing research into product development.
records.evidence_scope: The analytical region covers Shanghai, Hangzhou and Suzhou. Cited robot manufacture, R&D, training and product development are located in Shanghai and Hangzhou; customer sites retain their locations.
records.assessment_focus: Training infrastructure, robot products and physical research

records.name: Beijing Region
records.role: Robot learning, driving trials and growth funding
records.selection_rationale: Beijing brings robot-learning resources, developers, district-level driving trials and growth funding into the same regional network.
records.evidence_scope: Located developers, research, driving and delivery activity in Beijing municipality, with operating supervision and external customer locations separately recorded.
records.assessment_focus: Robot learning, driving trials and growth funding

records.name: Seoul Capital Area
records.role: Building deliveries, robot development and capital access
records.selection_rationale: The Seoul Capital Area connects research and manufacturing demand with internal building deliveries and capital-market access.
records.evidence_scope: Seoul, Incheon and Gyeonggi research and development; distinct activities at NAVER 1784 in Seongnam, ROBOTIS in Magok and Doosan in Suwon.
records.assessment_focus: Building deliveries, robot development and capital access

records.name: Boston Region
records.role: Hardware startups and shared robotics experimentation
records.selection_rationale: Greater Boston combines robot research, hardware companies and shared experimental space, with documented links to customer logistics.
records.evidence_scope: Greater Boston product development, research and shared experimentation linked to external customer operations; customer sites retain their locations.
records.assessment_focus: Hardware startups and shared robotics experimentation

records.name: Pittsburgh Region
records.role: Research transfer and manufacturing demonstrations
records.selection_rationale: Pittsburgh translates research into company technology transfer and manufacturing demonstrations.
records.evidence_scope: Pittsburgh and Allegheny County research, industrial product development, customer-pilot connections and shared manufacturing resources.
records.assessment_focus: Research transfer and manufacturing demonstrations

records.name: Munich Region
records.role: Industrial logistics integration and growth financing
records.selection_rationale: Munich’s robotics integration companies develop business around industrial customer logistics and growth financing.
records.evidence_scope: Munich city and Landkreis product, integration, research and financing activity; customer plants outside the region retain their locations.
records.assessment_focus: Industrial logistics integration and growth financing

records.name: Tokyo–Yokohama Core
records.role: Robot control, integration and testing access
records.selection_rationale: The Tokyo-centered region brings control and robotics companies together with capital and testing access.
records.evidence_scope: Tokyo-centered control, integration and research within the Tokyo-Yokohama-Kawasaki analytical region. Manufacturing and customer events retain their documented city locations.
records.assessment_focus: Robot control, integration and testing access

records.name: Stuttgart Region
records.role: AI manipulation and automotive testing infrastructure
records.selection_rationale: Stuttgart brings manufacturing and logistics customers together with AI manipulation and automotive testing requirements.
records.evidence_scope: Region Stuttgart development and shared industrial testing, including Fraunhofer IPA, University of Stuttgart and ARENA2036 facilities; partner facilities retain their own locations.
records.assessment_focus: AI manipulation and automotive testing infrastructure

records.name: Zurich Region
records.role: Learned inspection control and research commercialization
records.selection_rationale: Zurich’s product-development network includes learned control for industrial inspection robots and customer workflows.
records.evidence_scope: Located product development and research-commercialization links, with external inspection sites separately attributed.
records.assessment_focus: Learned inspection control and research commercialization

records.name: Singapore
records.role: Robot integration for customer infrastructure
records.selection_rationale: Singapore integrates foreign robots into customer infrastructure, with local inspection and operating responsibility.
records.evidence_scope: Located tunnel and retail integration, operator training and research resources; shared country and cluster events are cross-referenced.
records.assessment_focus: Robot integration for customer infrastructure

records.name: Odense
records.role: Mobile and collaborative-robot development
records.selection_rationale: Odense provides shared supply and development sites for mobile and collaborative robots.
records.evidence_scope: UR-MiR development infrastructure and DTI equipment, mentoring and incubation in Odense. National industry totals and customer operations retain separate scopes.
records.assessment_focus: Mobile and collaborative-robot development

records.name: Seattle Region
records.role: Logistics adopters, drone engineering and robot-data tools
records.selection_rationale: Seattle’s corporate and development network includes large logistics adopters and robot operating-data tools.
records.evidence_scope: Located drone engineering and manufacture, robot-data work and university research. BRINC's human-piloted missions and Amazon's external operating sites retain their respective attribution.

sources.title: BRINC announces new Seattle factory and next-generation 911 response drone

records.assessment_focus: Logistics adopters, drone engineering and robot-data tools

records.name: Aichi Manufacturing Region
records.role: Manufacturing development and robot testing facilities
records.selection_rationale: Aichi provides robot testing and support facilities serving manufacturing development.
records.evidence_scope: DENSO WAVE development and manufacture in Agui; Toyota City research and technology transfer. Toyota Motor East Japan customer production retains its external location.
records.assessment_focus: Manufacturing development and robot testing facilities

records.name: London Core — Cambridge Research and Startup Lineage
records.role: Action models, robot learning and driving development
records.selection_rationale: London develops action models, robot learning and vehicle systems toward physical products, with Cambridge represented through its research and founding lineage.
records.evidence_scope: Greater London development and supervised driving trials; joint dexterity research, reusable tools and completed financing. Cambridge retains its distinct lineage role.
records.assessment_focus: Action models, robot learning and driving development

records.name: Waterloo Core
records.role: Industrial AMRs, automation integration and services
records.selection_rationale: The Waterloo core brings industrial AMR products into large-scale automation integration and services.
records.evidence_scope: Kitchener-Waterloo-Cambridge supplier and research ecosystem, including ATS, OTTO, Avidbots, Deep Trekker, RoboHub and SMART Centre.
records.assessment_focus: Industrial AMRs, automation integration and services

records.name: Daejeon Core — Sejong–Osong Transport Links
records.role: Research platforms, technology transfer and demonstration labs
records.selection_rationale: Daejeon combines research platforms, technology transfer and robot startups with a physical AI demonstration lab.
records.evidence_scope: Located KAIST and ETRI research, planning and fleet-management transfer. Sejong and Osong retain their transport-link roles and site-specific attribution.
records.assessment_focus: Research platforms, technology transfer and demonstration labs

records.name: Pohang Industrial Robotics and Manufacturing Research Region
records.role: Robot manufacture and steel-industry development
records.selection_rationale: Pohang brings a robotics-company site together with a steel customer’s joint laboratory for manufacturing-oriented development.
records.evidence_scope: January 2026 photographed factory visit: Indy and OPTi assembly, actuator and motor production, calibration, aging and precision checks. Located learning-data hardware development and POSTECH research remain separately staged.
records.assessment_focus: Robot manufacture and steel-industry development

records.name: Austin Region
records.role: Humanoid development, customer trials and growth capital
records.selection_rationale: Austin-based Apptronik develops Apollo through Mercedes customer trials and growth financing. The customer trials took place in Germany.
records.evidence_scope: Austin MSA robot development and completed financing linked to Apptronik's Mercedes customer trials in Germany; training and production operation retain their distinct stages.
records.assessment_focus: Humanoid development, customer trials and growth capital
